prompts:
Use case: productivity-visual. Generate ONE complete slide4 for Sachet pitch deck. High-resolution flat landscape16:9. Style: white background, dark readable sans-serif typography, thin gray panel outlines, restrained orange label emphasis, tasteful orange dotted connectors, no decorative pictograms or cartoon icons. Match prior slides. Title top centered EXACT "How Sachet Works",54pt-equivalent. Main statement centered below32pt-equivalent EXACT "Sachet connects new requests to earlier claims, explains supported concerns," on first line and "and updates the same case as more context arrives." on second. Substantial content, not too empty, generous but efficient spacing, no huge white areas. Smallfooter "Sachet · Team ANKOR" left, "RAKSHAM · IIT Delhi | Statement 2" right.
Use upper horizontal FOUR-stage workflow, numbered01-04 connected by fine orange/gray arrows, each clear heading and2-line explanation:
"Share selected material" / "Submit chosen messages, screenshots or payment-request details."
"Connect the evidence" / "Link each new request to earlier claims in the same case."
"Assess the request" / "Explain supported concerns or ask for missing context."
"Guide the next step" / "Offer a specific verification action and let the user clarify."
Lower main area uses REAL supplied prototype captures. Image1 is true two-event evidence timeline with claimed ₹48,000 balance and demand for advance tax₹3,000; use as intact screenshot panel with caption "One case, developing context". Image2 is true current-assessment crop with "Pause & verify", condition-for-funds concern and verification action; use intact screenshot panel. Image3 is true evidence excerpt panel; use intact smaller screenshot beneath image2 or as inset. Retain original green/cream UI and readable genuine text, don't repaint orange, no fake interface labels, scores or capabilities. Image3 top has tiny navigation remnants; crop only those few top pixels for clarity. Retain source evidence beneath. Outside screenshots orange annotations may emphasize source relationship. Actual captured screenshots should dominate lower half, use focused screen crops faithfully.
Include compact text note heading "Continuity without repeated alerts", with3short lines EXACT "New context updates the existing case." "Corrections trigger reassessment." "An unchanged concern does not create a fresh alert."
Label source screenshots as "Evidence timeline" and "Updated assessment", with simple text "Revision 1 → Revision 2" outside screenshots. Smallprovenance footer "Local rules baseline · Synthetic test material". No claims of real-world accuracy or recipient identity, no 'safe', no member names, no 'illustrative scenario', no bottom orange slogan banner, no new giant icons. All English spelling accurate. Design3-stage underlying screenshots canbe arranged freely but FOUR-stage mainflow must clearly present all steps.
VARIANT1: Balanced engineering/product layout. Four equal flat numbered stage cards across upper band. Below, left43% wide timeline screenshot frame, center40% two stacked assessment+source screenshot frames, right17% narrow text continuity column separated by fine verticalgray line. Use modest heading captions and readable outer text. Timeline and assessment screenshot text should be large enough to inspect. Fine dotted orange curvedconnector from secondtimeline event to source excerpt panel. Clean aligned rows.
